answer: Random peer audits stop bulk fakes. Each agent enters on a terrace by posting one bond worth twice its 30-day earnings. Each epoch the network randomly assigns it to audit three peers over a 30-day horizon, checking real work. Forging 1,000 identities costs 1,000 bonds and 3,000 fake records, far more than any reward. An honest agent pays once, earns a pearl per clean audit, and keeps undiluted rewards while fakes fail and forfeit bonds.
